messages.subject: Lavaan Syntax Second-Order CFA
parts:
Hi everyone! I am running lavaan syntax manually to check for measurement invariance across the 2 categories of gender (male and female): I constrain  the factor loadings (at the 1st and 2nd order) and the threshoolds to be equal across the two groups. 

I am writing the syntax manually.

Does this syntax look good to you?

Do I need to add anything else to the part on covariances (residual covariances + covariances between the latent factors)?

# FACTOR LOADINGS

life_sat =~ c(1, 1)*stflife + c(lambda.1_1, lambda.1_1)*stflife
life_sat=~ c(NA, NA)*stflfsf + c(lambda.2_1, lambda.2_1)*stflfsf

pos_affect =~ c(1, 1)*wrhpp + c(lambda.4_2, lambda.4_2)*wrhpp
pos_affect =~ c(NA, NA)*enjlf + c(lambda.5_2, lambda.5_2)*enjlf
pos_affect =~ c(NA, NA)*enrglot + c(lambda.6_.2, lambda.6_2)*enrglot

neg_affect =~ c(1, 1)*fltanx + c(lambda.8_3, lambda.8_3)*fltanx
neg_affect =~ c(NA, NA)*fltsd + c(lambda.9_3, lambda.9_3)*fltsd
neg_affect =~ c(NA, NA)*fltdpr + c(lambda.10_3, lambda.10_3)*fltdpr

well_being =~ c(1,1)*life_sat + c(beta.1_1,beta.1_1)*life_sat
well_being =~ c(NA, NA)*pos_affect + c(beta.2_1, beta.2_1)*pos_affect
well_being =~ c(NA, NA)*neg_affect + c(beta.3_1, beta.3_1)*neg_affect

self_esteem =~ c(1, 1)*pstvms + c(lambda.15_4, lambda.15_4)*pstvms
self_esteem =~ c(NA, NA)*flrms + c(lambda.16_4, lambda.16_4)*flrms

social_support =~ c(1, 1)*ppllfcr + c(lambda.17_5, lambda.17_5)*ppllfcr
social_support =~ c(NA, NA)*inmdisc + c(lambda.18_5, lambda.18_5)*inmdisc
         

# THRESHOLDS
 
stflife | c(NA, NA)*t1 + c(stflife.thr1, stflife.thr1)*t1
stflife | c(NA, NA)*t2 + c(stflife.thr2, stflife.thr2)*t2

# COVARIANCES BETWEEN 1-ST ORDER LATENT VARIABLES

life_satisfaction+pos_affect ~~ 0*neg_affect
life_satisfaction ~~ 0*pos_affect

enrglot ~~ NA*flttrd
